passages.provision_quote: If a post is determined to meet the requirements for removal pursuant to subdivision (a), any large online platform shall remove the post upon that determination, but no later than 72 hours after a report is made pursuant to subdivision (a) of Section 20515 in order to be in compliance with this chapter.
passages.note: Berman is the named author of the chaptered bill, whose operative section imposes a legal duty on large online platforms to remove false content, with labeling as an additional duty rather than a substitute.

rows.reasoning: Berman authored AB 2655 (2023-2024), which provides that "any large online platform shall remove the post upon that determination, but no later than 72 hours after a report is made", a legal mandate enforceable by injunctive relief sought by candidates, officials, the Attorney General, a district attorney or a city attorney. That matches the rung "legally require platforms to remove false information". The rung "require platforms to label false content, rather than remove it" is excluded because the bill mandates removal in addition to labeling, and the voluntary-standards and no-government-involvement rungs are excluded because the duty is statutory and government-enforced.
